summary: Policy clarification: two-week 'mentor-bridge' elevated SSH & loaner M1 laptop allocation for EU contractor pilot
description:
Issue summary:
HR is piloting a two-week 'mentor-bridge' program for an EU-based contractor (start: 2026-03-15, end: 2026-03-29). They request timebound elevated SSH access to a small set of internal jump hosts, temporary membership in the 'onboarding-mentors' group (which currently grants limited sudo for package install only), and a loaner Apple M1 laptop shipped to an EU office.

Background / Why we need this:
- The contractor will shadow a senior eng for 2 weeks to accelerate ramp. Mentor needs the contractor to access internal dev VMs and run a small ops script for environment repro.
- HR and manager prefer a single-window approval flow to avoid delays across IT, Security, and Facilities.

Request details:
- Access: SSH access to jump1.eu.redwood.internal and jump2.eu.redwood.internal, timebound (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-29). Temporary group: onboarding-mentors (proposed).
- Privilege scope: NON-PERSISTENT sudo limited to /usr/bin/apt-get and /usr/bin/systemctl only; no kube or prod access.
- Device: loaner MacBook Air (M1), encrypted, company-managed, shipped to EU office. Inventory tag required and loaner agreement signed.
- Audit: we need explicit audit logging and an approval trail saved to Confluence or ticket.

Questions for Security/IT policy owners (this ticket):
1) Is temporary group membership + timebound expiration acceptable policy for contractors in EU? Any additional consent or DPA language required for laptop shipment?
2) Does scoped sudo to apt/systemctl meet our least-privilege standard, or must we provision a dedicated service account and use bastion jump with session recording?
3) Which approval chain is required (HR -> Manager -> Security -> IT)? Can we enable a single approval via Delegated Requests for short pilots?
4) Are there existing runbooks for laptop wipe/return and KMS rekey for EU loaners we should attach to the onboarding checklist?

Impact if not resolved:
- Onboarding delay of the contractor by >2 weeks, blocking project ramp and mentor availability.
- HR admin overhead handling multiple manual approvals and courier scheduling.

Proposed mitigations / suggested controls:
- Timebound access via SCIM or ephemeral tokens with automatic expiry (preferred).
- Session-recorded bastion SSH with write-restricted sudo and forced-command wrapper for permitted operations.
- Hardware shipped with MDM enrollment and preconfigured disk encryption. Return/wipe process documented with Facilities.

Attachments / links:
- Manager note: Confluence: Mentor-Bridge Pilot (internal) - https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Mentor-Bridge-Pilot
- Draft loaner agreement: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/IT/Loaner-Agreement-Draft

Desired outcome / acceptance criteria:
- Clear policy guidance documented here with named approvers and required controls.
- Temporary access flow approved or alternative process prescribed (e.g., service account + recorded bastion sessions).
- ETA for laptop provisioning and shipping window confirmed by Facilities/Procurement.
